title: The Preeminence of Christ
speaker: Pastor Dennis Leman

outline.title: Christ as Creator
subpoints: All things in heaven and earth were created through Him and for Him
Christ sustains all things, including the visible and invisible realms
The universe exists by His power, refuting naturalistic origins

outline.title: Christ as Redeemer
subpoints: Redemption is accomplished through His blood
Believers are delivered from the power of darkness into the Kingdom of Light
The Father qualifies believers to share in the inheritance of the saints

outline.title: Christ as Reconciler
subpoints: All things are reconciled to God through Christ
Peace is made through the blood of His cross
Believers are presented holy, blameless, and above reproach

summary:
In this sermon, Pastor Dennis Leman explores the preeminence of Christ as presented in Colossians 1. The message emphasizes that Jesus Christ holds supreme authority over all creation because He is the agent of creation, through whom all things in heaven and on earth were made and are sustained. This theological foundation establishes Christ's right to be exalted above all powers, principalities, and visible or invisible realms.

The sermon further highlights the work of redemption, noting that believers are delivered from the power of darkness and conveyed into the kingdom of the Son of God's love. Through His blood, Christ provides forgiveness of sins and qualifies believers to partake in the inheritance of the saints. This redemption is not merely a legal transaction but a transformative move from alienation to reconciliation.

Finally, the message addresses the cosmic scope of reconciliation, where Christ makes peace through the blood of His cross, reconciling all things to Himself. Believers who were once enemies are now presented holy and blameless in God's sight. The sermon concludes by urging the congregation to recognize Christ's preeminence in all aspects of life, ensuring that worship and daily conduct reflect His supreme authority.
